# ETSI European Telecommunications Standards Institute

The European Telecommunications Standards Institute (ETSI) produces globally-applicable standards for Information and Communications Technologies (ICT), including fixed, mobile, radio, converged, broadcast and internet technologies.

* [ETSI Official Website](http://www.etsi.org/)

## About

ETSI is a European standardization organization that develops standards for ICT sectors worldwide. Their standards cover a wide range of technologies and communications infrastructure.
